explanation._note: Documentation only; ignored by run_pruning.py. Paths are relative to the project root unless absolute.
explanation.data_path: Path to the .npz file produced by generate_data.py. Must contain X, Y, and centers_global (RBF centers are chosen at data-generation time via compute_k_means, n_global_centers, and random_center_seed in generate_duffing_data.json—not in this file).
explanation.d_poly: Total degree of the polynomial part of the dictionary. Use -1 for RBFs only (no polynomial). Use 0, 1, 2, ... to include monomials up to that degree via CombinedDictionary(RBF, polynomial).
explanation.gamma: Bandwidth parameter for the Gaussian radial basis functions, exp(-gamma * ||x - c||^2). Larger gamma makes each RBF more localized around its center.
explanation.epsilon_pre_pruning: Threshold passed to MPV_SPV_rank_one via the info dict for the optional pre-pruning step (filtered modes before the main algorithm).
explanation.epsilon: Tolerance/threshold passed to MPV_SPV_rank_one for the main pruning step.
explanation.verbose: If true, MPV_SPV_rank_one prints progress and diagnostic output.
explanation.data_file_path: Where to write pruning_output.npz. Contains Phi_X, Phi_Y, gamma, d_poly, S_final, subspace_dims, sin_decreasing (IPT curve), and S_saved_<dim> arrays for each saved pruning step from MPV_SPV_rank_one.
